q: Input-to-State Stability (ISS) of a control system ẋ = f(x,u) means:
opts: The system is stable with u = 0
The state x(t) is bounded by a KL function of x(0) plus a K function of sup|u|
The system has a quadratic Lyapunov function
All solutions converge to zero for any bounded input
exp: ISS: the state satisfies |x(t)| ≤ β(|x(0)|, t) + γ(||u||∞) with β a KL function and γ a class K function. This captures both stability (β → 0) and robustness to bounded disturbances.
